training: Only budgeted source-LODO query errors of frozen B and B1; no M2 risk pseudo-out-of-fold labels. B-trained corrector applies to B/B2; B1-trained to B1/B12, with parent prediction as covariate.
features: Relative charge geometry plus parent prediction minus firstK SOH mean; ridge alpha=10 or scalar RBF GP
selection: Original fold validation domain-equal MAE, ties prefer smaller correction. Freeze before test predictions opened.
acceptance: Same eight-group, three-dataset three-metric gates as geometry screen; statistical intervals separate.
limits: Parent-distribution transfer to M2 is a hypothesis, not guaranteed
Development results are not independent confirmation
